interpretation.fix: Only the unavailable-openat2 read-only directory-route fallback changes. Each component and link is pinned by an owned O_PATH fd; relative/absolute targets stay within the saved root, user .. uses the saved stack, procfs links are conservatively rejected, and final reopening uses the still-owned fd rather than its replaceable pathname.
interpretation.directComparison: Old a260ef308 fails the new case in all 10 rounds with 60 outside-root synthetic sentinel reads. New bytes pass the same 24 definitions except the expected revision; regular/internal-link requests remain usable and all 60 formerly failing escape assertions reject the sentinel.
interpretation.raceBoundary: Pinned-file/link replacement, detected moved parents, concurrent link swaps and errors are tested. This is not proof of exhaustive openat2 equivalence, an immutable filesystem snapshot, protection against hostile same-process FD tampering, privileged mount changes or arbitrary filesystem implementations.
interpretation.syscallBoundary: Unavailable-before-filter phases do not prove first-entry high-level EIO/TRAP reachability. Raw controls are not six high-level fallback acceptances; public Android lchmod exports remain absent and internal sys::lchmod/CLI fallback remains untested.
